name: Pasted plain text
about: Notes pasted as plain lines (no headings, no lists): the first short line is the title with the line under it, and numbered lines typed as paragraphs are one list of points.

runs.text: 1. Everything that can be shaken will be shaken
2. What God builds can’t be shaken
3. So we worship with reverence and awe
Next step: Write down one thing you’re holding onto.
